verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a Usage API that returns real-time credit and concurrency usage for the account. That is a programmatic, account-level view of capacity consumption, not a real-time dashboard of system metrics or worker/browser pool status. Missing for 10: any documented real-time visual dashboard, browser/worker pool status visibility, broader system metrics (latency, error rates, throughput), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
